title: Cortex TrainingLabel (DRAFT v0)
description: A raw quality label emitted by Quorum/Maestro for a single routed request — the auto-labeling flywheel's output row (Quorum quality_labels table) and Forge's harvest input. Distinct from TrainingDataCandidate (the curated, lane-ready example). Carries optional `provenance` so a source-grounded label can survive Forge's curate grounding gate; an ungrounded label omits it and is correctly rejected as fuel. Join key `decision_id` ties back to RouteDecision. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer. Status: DRAFT; bump $id on breaking changes.

decision_id.description: RouteDecision.decision_id — join key to the originating route, Quorum label, and Mnemos memory. Null for labels written outside a routed dispatch.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds when the label was written.

domain.description: Maestro task domain (code/reason/agent/...); maps to a Forge lane via DOMAIN_TO_ADAPTER.

voter_responses.description: Per-voter raw responses (object, or its JSON-string form as persisted in sqlite).

model_votes.description: Per-model scores (object, or its JSON-string form).

lane.description: Optional explicit Forge lane override; when absent, the consumer derives it from `domain`.

provenance.description: Source-grounding metadata. Present only for grounded tasks (e.g. a code dispatch with a known repo/commit). When present, all three fields are required so Forge's curate grounding gate can pass. When absent/null, the label is honestly ungrounded and is not eligible as training fuel.

source_url.description: URL of the source the routed work was grounded in (repo, PR, issue).

source_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA at harvest time.
